description: Pans each channel of a polyphonic cable across a stereo pair, every channel swept by the same triangle at a different point in its cycle, and the results summed

params.text: Sets the sweep speed in beats per minute, 0.1 to 500
Scales both outputs, from silence to twice the input

inputs.text: The signal to be panned; each channel of a polyphonic cable takes its own place in the sweep
Replaces the Rate knob while a cable is patched: -10V gives 0.1 beats per minute, 0V gives 250, and +10V gives 500

outputs.text: The right side of the panned pair, one channel
The left side of the panned pair, one channel

notes: the pan law is linear rather than constant power: the two outputs sum to the input at every point in the sweep, so the middle of the sweep is quieter than the ends
both outputs are monophonic; every channel of the input is summed into them
